versions.changelog: Fix: ethers dependency (v5 → v6). Version 1.3.0 was broken due to accidental npm audit fix --force before publishing.

Version 1.3.0 introduces input validation, improved test coverage, and build tooling.

- Added input validators for commands (see new src/lib/validators.js)
- Introduced unit tests for core logic (new /tests with chain, output, and validator tests)
- Added build script (scripts/build.js) and Vitest config for testing
- Updated several core command files with validation and minor improvements
- Documentation updates in README.md and SKILL.md
- Package and lockfile updated for dependencies and test tooling

- Added support for deploying new tokens with the new create-token command.
- Updated documentation to include create-token usage, options, and workflow.
- create-token sends logo to IPFS and deploys token + bonding curve in one step.
- HODL_PRIVATE_KEY is now required for create-token as well as buy/sell.
- Minor clarifications and enhancements to SKILL.md instructions and error codes.

- Added full documentation in SKILL.md, covering all commands, usage, and output format.
- Provides detailed instructions for buying and selling tokens, including automatic ERC20 approve handling for sales.
- Lists API endpoints, contract addresses, environment variables, and agent workflow for trading memecoins on HODL.DANCE.
- Describes all command-line options, expected outputs (including JSON format), and error handling codes.
- Makes credential requirements and operational safety notes clear for users.
